title: Nunu Hunter
reason: VDRJ solo-kills Tristana diff's Nunu for the second time in under 40 seconds, flipping the script on the jungler who had killed them earlier.

title: First Solo Kill
reason: After three straight assists, VDRJ finally takes a kill for themselves, deleting the enemy Caitlyn.

title: Double Trouble
reason: VDRJ kills Aatrox and immediately sets up Caitlyn's death three seconds later in a huge teamfight swing.

title: Traded With Singed
reason: Singed takes VDRJ down but gets deleted three seconds later — a perfectly timed revenge from the team.

title: Last Word
reason: VDRJ's final act is one more Caitlyn kill before dying seconds later as the winning game closes out.
